Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying. Never on quota_exceeded.

X-Request-Id.description: The request's ID, in every log line and its Trails event.

IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key and request get the stored response.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

AccessDenied.description: access_denied: the caller's policies don't allow the action; forbidden_origin: a cookie-authenticated write from an origin that isn't allowed; spend_limit_reached.

Conflict.description: quota_exceeded (an allocation quota, with quota), idempotency_conflict, idempotency_in_progress (with Retry-After), organization_deletion_pending, operation_in_progress, or the endpoint's own 409 codes.

InternalError.description: internal_error: a bug; the details are in the logs, under the request ID.

InvalidRequest.description: invalid_request (with issues), invalid_cursor, or the endpoint's own 400 codes.

NotFound.description: not_found: unknown, malformed, or in an organization the caller isn't in.

PayloadTooLarge.description: payload_too_large: the body is over the endpoint's limit (1 MiB unless it says otherwise).

TooManyRequests.description: too_many_requests, with Retry-After; or quota_exceeded (a rate, usage or concurrency quota, with quota), never with Retry-After.

Unauthenticated.description: unauthenticated: no credential, or one that doesn't check out.

Unavailable.description: unavailable: a dependency the request needs is down. Retry after Retry-After.

issuer.description: Who issues the certificate: the public CA (publicAcme, the default) or one of the project's private certificate authorities (privateCa)

notAfter.description: When the active version expires; null without one

renewAt.description: When the active version is due for renewal; null without one or before it is scheduled

crlThisUpdate.description: thisUpdate of the CA's newest CRL; null before the first

revokedAt.description: When a subordinate was revoked through its parent (it then stays disabled); null otherwise

CertificateAuthorityAccepted.description: The certificate authority as it is now and the operation that finishes the change. An Idempotency-Key replay answers the operation alone, as it is then.

maxLeafValidityDays.description: Subordinates only, default 90; may later only shrink

nameConstraints.description: Fixed at creation. DNS and URI entries: a host or .domain; email: a mailbox, host or .domain; IP: a masked CIDR prefix. A hosted subordinate's are within its parent's.

parentId.description: A hosted subordinate's parent CA, in the same project (needs certificates.certificateAuthorities.issue on it)

parentKind.description: Subordinates only: hosted (the default) or external (signed by your own root, then imported)

pathLength.description: Roots -1 (unlimited) to 2, default 1; subordinates 0 to 2 and below the parent's, default 0

validityDays.description: Roots 365-9132, default 3650; subordinates 365-3653, default 1825 (never past the parent's notAfter)

certificatePem.description: The external subordinate's certificate, signed by your CA from its CSR

chainPem.description: The CA certificates above it, nearest first, up to your root

issuer.description: Absent or publicAcme: the public CA, through the domain authorizations. privateCa: a subordinate certificate authority in this project (certificates.certificateAuthorities.issue on it); domainAuthorizationIds is then empty or absent and the CA's name constraints govern the names.

diagnostics.description: What the last DNS checks found, for this authorization's own names only. At most one problem entry (the last failed check: code, safe message, checkedAt; it has no name) comes first; the other entries are what the last successful check saw per name and perspective, kept when a later check fails. A successful check replaces the array with its checks.

nextCheckAt.description: When the next DNS check runs: after a failed check, when it is retried

dnsZoneId.description: The EZGH DNS zone (zon_…) the validation record sets are written into; null when the records are yours to publish.

DomainCheck.description: What a successful DNS check saw for one of the authorization's names (it or its wildcard) from one perspective.

owner.description: Where the relevant CAA record set was found; empty when there is none

caa.description: The CAA lookup, or null when the check made none (a transfer's ownership proof)

perspective.description: The resolver or authoritative name server that answered

DomainCheckProblem.description: The last failed DNS check of the authorization.

code.description: A check code: binding_missing, binding_conflict, binding_indirect, delegation_mismatch, challenge_not_visible, authority_changed, resolver_disagreement, dns_authority_unavailable, dns_lookup_failed, dns_query_budget_exhausted, caa_denied, caa_critical, domain_owned_elsewhere, dependency_unavailable, …; new codes may be added

message.description: A fixed, safe sentence for the code

Error.description: Every non-2xx answer. Clients branch on code, never on message.

issues.description: invalid_request: one entry per problem, at a dotted path.

PrivateCARequest.description: Placeholder until the owning team defines this request

privateKey.description: ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY PEM: PKCS#8, PBES2 with AES-256-CBC and PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600,000 iterations) under the passphrase

csr.description: PEM CSR; its signature proves possession. Only its key, common name and SANs are used.

commonName.description: On tlsServer and tlsServerClient, a host-name common name must be one of the DNS SANs

sans.description: Canonicalized (lowercase A-label DNS names, canonical IPs); at most 100 in all, each within the CA's name constraints

PrivateCertificateIssueAccepted.description: The issuing operation; its target is the certificate once signed. An Idempotency-Key replay answers the operation alone, as it is then.

reason.description: keyCompromise also retires a generated key

QuotaExceeded.description: quota_exceeded: the quota that refused the request. Never with Retry-After.

window.description: rate only: an ISO 8601 duration, PT1S to PT1H.

apiKey.description: A customer API key: Bearer ezgh_…

oauth.description: An OAuth access token (Bearer ezgh_at_…) or an EZGH SSO resource token (Bearer ezgh_sat_…)
